overview.description: The T. Rowe Price Global Equity ETF (TGLB) is an exchange-traded fund. The fund's investment portfolio concentrates primarily on total market equity. TGLB is an actively managed fund that seeks long-term capital appreciation through investments in global equities, including emerging markets TGLB was launched on Jun 25, 2025 and is issued by T. Rowe Price.
